title: You Can Play Video Games Inside GTA 6 🎮 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 has a game console inside the game. The JoySystem by the TV in your safehouse runs three playable games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind. You first play them in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal. A fourth game, Bang For Your Buck, is only on arcade machines around the map. Finish every level of any one game to unlock the Stick Fiddler trophy.

Sources: PowerPyx (GTA 6 All Video Game Locations), Windows Central (funniest GTA 6 clips so far).
Images: official Rockstar Games footage (An Extended Look, Trailer 2, official screenshot). Arcade scene is illustrative.
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
